data.title: Olymel brand Chicken Breast Strips recalled due to Listeria monocytogenes
data.description: In Ottawa on September 11, 2026, it was reported that Chicken Breast Strips are being recalled in Quebec due to microbial contamination of Listeria. The Canadian Food Inspection Agency has issued a recall for the affected products. For more information, individuals can refer to the source provided by the agency.

data.title: Super Micro Computer Investigation Initiated: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC Investigates the Officers and Directors of Super Micro Computer, Inc. - SMCI

data.title: New Mud Springs Trail System Opens Near Moab, Expanding World-Class Mountain Biking Opportunities
data.description: A recent addition to the Moab area's acclaimed mountain biking scene is the Mud Springs Trail System, located in MOAB, Utah. Opened on September 11, 2026, this race-ready network features trails catering to a diverse range of riders, including youth racers, adaptive cyclists, families, and individuals of different skill levels. The system is set to enhance the region's biking options, offering a mix of challenges and experiences for enthusiasts.

data.title: Achieve Publishes New Online Guidance for Freedom Debt Relief and Achieve Customers
data.description: A company based in San Mateo, California, released a new online tool on Sept. 11, 2026. Achieve introduced a resource to offer customers transparent guidance. This initiative, within a financial wellness ecosystem, aims to assist consumers in comprehending important information.

data.title: India's imports from China have surged, creating a trade deficit and a dilemma for New Delhi's industrial growth.
data.description: Over the span of five years, the trade volume between India and China has seen almost a twofold increase, showcasing a significant rise. This surge has resulted in a growing deficit for New Delhi. Consequently, it has put the Indian government in a challenging position, prompting them to contemplate strategic decisions regarding the development of their industrial sector.

data.title: ICW Group Honors 25th Anniversary of Sept. 11 Through Day of Service
data.description: On September 11, 2026, in San Diego, ICW Group Insurance Companies participated in commemorating the 25th anniversary of the tragic events of September 11th by teaming up with numerous volunteers nationwide to assemble approximately 20 million meals for individuals experiencing food insecurity. The initiative was coordinated by the nonprofit organization 9/11 Day, with the aim of providing substantial support to those in need.

data.title: PerZeption Awarded NEI Phase 1 SBIR Grant for Age-related Macular Degeneration Study
data.description: In Boston on September 11, 2026, PerZeption Inc. was granted a Phase I Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) award by the National Eye Institute (NEI) for their initiative titled "Efficient Achromatic and Chromatic Photostress Recovery Assessment for Age-related Macular Degeneration."

data.title: SYNCERE introduces LUME during New York Fashion Week
data.description: A new innovative product called LUME is being launched by SYNCERE in New York, representing a lamp that doubles as a household chore assistant. This device autonomously performs daily tasks like folding laundry and making the bed, all while also functioning as an aesthetically pleasing source of light in the home. SYNCERE will be unveiling LUME during New York Fashion Week, where it will be actively assisting backstage at the Altuzarra and Advsry shows. This integration showcases the intersection of fashion, home decor, design, and technology.

data.title: QIVIKA to Launch Smart Scope on Kickstarter, Bringing a Professional Long-Range Experience to Day-and-Night Exploration
data.description: Today, QIVIKA, a consumer technology firm specializing in smartphone-based optical imaging solutions, revealed that the QIVIKA Smart Scope will debut on Kickstarter on September 15, 2026. The device offers a portable optical system that has been carefully crafted for user convenience. It combines cutting-edge technology with practicality, catering to the needs of modern consumers. This launch marks a significant step for the company as it aims to make innovative optical imaging accessible to a broader audience.

data.title: WAFD SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Ademi LLP Investigates Whether Buyout Fairly Values WaFd, Inc.
data.description: Ademi LLP is currently conducting an investigation into the proposed merger agreement that will result in WaFd shareholders owning approximately 40.825% of the combined company. data.title: Computer Modelling Group Announces Annual General Meeting Voting Results
data.description: In Calgary, Alberta, on September 11, 2026, Computer Modelling Group Ltd. disclosed the outcomes of its annual general shareholder meeting held on September 10, 2026. data.title: LHC Group Data Breach: Edelson Lechtzin LLP Launches Investigation Into Exposure of Personal Information
data.description: A prominent national class action law firm, Edelson Lechtzin LLP, is providing complimentary case assessments for individuals affected by the recent cybersecurity breach involving the LHC Group. The evaluation offer aims to assist those impacted by providing them with legal guidance and support. The investigation into this matter involves significant numbers of individuals who may have been affected by the breach.

data.title: FCPT Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Monthly Dividends
data.description: A real estate investment trust, Four Corners Property Trust, Inc. (NYSE: FCPT), based in Mill Valley, California, declared monthly cash dividends of $0.1265 per share ($1.5180 per share annually) for the fourth quarter of 2026. The dividends will be payable in cash to common stock shareholders of record as of the record date. This marks a 3.5% increase from the previous quarter. The payment dates are outlined in a table provided by the company's Board of Directors.
